Upwind advection
a+ = max(a, 0), a − = min(a, 0).

pages.title: An exact shift of the cell vector
pages.text:
An exact shift of the cell vector
For D = 0 and ν = 1,
cn+1i = cni−1.
Negative velocity reverses the shift. This identity ﬁxes the indexing convention.

pages.title: Constant and stationary states
pages.text:
Constant and stationary states
If ci = c0, every ﬂux diﬀerence is zero.
If a = D = 0, every cell is unchanged, including

pages.title: Numerical diffusion
pages.text:
Numerical diﬀusion
For smooth pure advection with a > 0, the leading modiﬁed equation is
ct + acx = a∆x2 (1 − ν)cxx + · · · .
Upwind smoothing can occur even when the physical D is zero.

pages.title: Transport mechanisms and model interpretation
pages.text:
Transport mechanisms and model interpretation
A tracer requires a justiﬁed velocity ﬁeld and inlet conditions. An activation model
requires reaction kinetics.
The same balance structure can support these models, but the
scalar pulse does not supply their missing physics.
Computational Cardiology Notes 19 / 19
